denial.payer_remark: Service not deemed medically necessary on the information submitted.

visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-05-05
Patient: 53-year-old man, established patient.
Chief complaint: left knee pain
History: left knee pain for 10 days after a fall. No treatment yet.
Examination: deferred; patient in a hurry.
Assessment: knee pain.
Plan: MRI of the left knee without contrast.
Signed: treating clinician. 2026-05-05.

expected.rationale: The policy needs a positive examination finding or weeks of failed conservative treatment (6 for this payer). The knee was not examined and no treatment was tried, so neither criterion was met at the time of service. There is nothing to retrieve: asking for examination findings now would invite a chart entry written after the denial. The denial stands.
